description: Requires an API key. The state of a payment from lunium_pay_pix_with_usdt. final=true means it will not change anymore. concluido: show pix_e2e, recipient_name, recipient_document (partial) and receipt_url. falhou: not executed, the reserve returned. falhou_apos_envio: under investigation — never pay again; tell the user it is being checked. revisao: being checked, not a failure. Poll at most every 10-15 seconds.
name: lunium_get_usdt_pix_payment
